description:
## Verified problem

The `make_reducer` even/gt2 witness settles two semantic reducer activations. Each captured predicate is carried as `ValueRef` and invoked through an indirect closure call. Both semantic identities and both predicate construction words are observable, while their completed native reducer and continuation graphs are physically equivalent. Compiling both graphs duplicates native work.

The direct-carrier control `mk(double)` / `mk(triple)` is different: its lambda bodies contain distinct grounded local targets and must not share.

## Goal

Retain every semantic activation and runtime construction identity while compiling one physical native CPS graph for sibling activations whose complete native graphs are equivalent. The sharing pass must perform bounded deterministic work and leave codegen with materially less work.

## Current integration base

The proven replay is staged on parent `29e89d4ac4ab53c25af4d52023cb23eddc5bafd9`, which composes PR #110 head `c2c723c63afdbda22078bb0a164cb313b8c7dfa8` with the preceding approved fz-tfn replay commits. All counts below are measured on this combined stack, not the retired `21711b335` base.

## Chosen boundary and strategy

`NativeProgram` is the ownership boundary. `BackendProgram` remains the interpreter semantic and index authority; merging there would erase semantic identity or require a parallel remap before native ABI, direct targets, construction words, and the complete CPS graph are explicit.

`NativeProgram.executable_entries` keeps one `ExecutableKey -> FnId` row per semantic executable while permitting several rows to name one physical entry. Programs with no same-function sibling entries return before building a native ownership index. For actual candidates, each fixed-point pass builds one ephemeral index over native bodies and IR control edges. Executable roots and clause indices seed graph ownership; continuations receive structural roles from first-reachable completed-IR control-edge paths. Temporal continuation indices are absent from `NativeBodyOrigin`, so allocation and inventory order cannot become semantic identity. A graph containing an owned body with no structural control path is ineligible rather than receiving a guessed fallback role.

Comparison alpha-renames only graph-owned `FnId`s, diagnostic function names, and same-span callsite allocation identities. Direct targets, construction words, ABI and representation facts, effects, captures, extern marshals, and every other codegen-relevant type compare exactly. A type may differ only for a `ValueRef` variable exhaustively proven by the IR-use walk to occur solely as the callee word of an indirect closure call. No display or rendered type string participates in semantic authority.

Every accepted mapping rewrites the physical module entry, semantic entry target, callable-boundary target, continuation owner, and CPS control edge; removes redundant bodies and functions; and rebuilds the module function index. Construction-producing IR is not remapped. `ExecutableKey` rows remain the semantic inventory throughout.

## Measured signal on the combined stack

The deterministic census selects 510 candidates: 474 resolve, 2 hit the known pre-existing lowering panics, and 34 are expected fatal or unresolved fixtures. Of the resolved programs, 472 compile successfully both before and after sharing.

Sharing preserves all 5,760 semantic executable entries and all 118 `MakeClosure` instructions while reducing:

- physical executable roots: 5,760 -> 5,707 (-53)
- owned continuations: 8,625 -> 8,487 (-138)
- all native bodies: 15,760 -> 15,569 (-191)
- compiled native text: 3,459,136 -> 3,412,776 bytes (-46,360)

The zero-candidate path avoids ownership-index work entirely. Candidate programs perform exactly 204 ownership-index passes over 18,406 bodies and 17,608 structurally reachable graph-body roles, with 6,767 graph comparisons and 6,071 body comparisons. The retained warm sample spent 79.026 ms sharing while paired codegen moved from 12,882 ms to 12,361 ms. Deterministic body, byte, and work counters are the primary proof; elapsed measurements are corroborative and are not acceptance thresholds.

## Safety and acceptance

- The exact even/gt2 reducer matches Elixir on interpreter, JIT, and AOT.
- The boxed pair begins as disjoint complete graphs, differs only at proven indirect-callee `ValueRef` types, retains both semantic activations and predicate construction words, and maps to one physical graph.
- Reversing helper and body inventory order preserves structural equivalence.
- Detaching a real continuation control edge makes its graph ineligible, prevents fixed-point sharing, and leaves the helper and owner internally valid after unrelated remaps.
- `mk(double)` / `mk(triple)` retains two physical graphs and distinct grounded direct targets.
- Dynamic callable construction, capture layouts, ABI and representation facts, effects, extern marshals, recursive-search telemetry, semantic-to-physical movement, schema-only native-program movement, and combined-stack behavior remain green.
- The retained census reproduces the exact population, reductions, and bounded work counts above with no unexplained behavior movers.
- No test requires duplicate bodies, and programs without sibling candidates perform no graph-index work.
- `cargo fmt --check`, strict all-target/all-feature clippy, `cargo test --lib`, `cargo test --test fz2_cli`, and the complete fixture matrix pass.

## Remaining composition obligation

An owned native body with no completed-IR structural path remains conservatively ineligible for sharing. `fz-tfn.27` owns deleting dead branch/resume helpers at their emitter before final epic acceptance; this ticket neither invents fallback ownership nor hides them.

comments.text: Reopened during cumulative current-base review: the original normalized comparer saved 44,272 emitted bytes but temporary census instrumentation measured 4,924 graph / 5,698 body comparisons across 488 passes and ~1.516s sharing cost versus ~1.179s codegen reduction, with a ~586ms worst case and hash/early-exit-dependent comparison counts. This violates the arc performance goal. Retain the native ownership boundary, but replace repeated full-body scans with deterministic indexed/canonical ownership (or a simpler measured equivalent), remove probes, and re-run exact output/work/behavior gates before cold review and delivery.

title: Boxed captured-callable specializations duplicate native CPS bodies despite distinct semantic identities
